body:
Parent: #2184
Depends on: #2694

## 原子目标

只消费 #2694 cleanup/consumer-inventory receipt，执行 auth truth 全仓 scanner、父票反例/mutation、truth/permission/duration/refresh parity、canonical-bypass-legacy隔离与 secret治理，并签发 terminal acceptance receipt。该 issue 不修改 truth registry、session producers、permission catalog、Cookie serializers或 refresh/revocation产品逻辑。

## 输入与输出

- `config/testing/auth-truth-consumers.json` 与 #2694 verified cleanup receipt。
- #2181 truth registry、#2182 canonical session、#2183 bypass/legacy isolation receipts。
- 新增 `tools/test/check-auth-truth-governance.mjs`、`tests/tools/auth-truth-governance.test.mjs`。
- 输出 `.tmp/test-evidence/auth-truth-acceptance.json`，schema `fsusblog.auth-truth-acceptance.v1`。

## 必须交付

1. Scanner覆盖 C#/JS/TS/shell/workflow/package/config/docs，识别 hand-signed JWT、direct session/refresh/credential/proof writes、placeholder credentials、legacy strength、claim-only step-up、hardcoded permission map、duration hardcode、truth filename/JWT inference、old readers/compat/second producer/verifier与 warning path。
2. Mutation fixtures稳定杀死：placeholder credential、JWT strength mismatch、MFA mismatch、step-up cross-action/replay/expiry、refresh auth-time/strength/proof drift、permission errors、legacy/bypass canonical acceptance与 Cookie/server duration mismatch。
3. #2181 registry、#2182/#2183 receipts与 actual consumers双向 exact；新增 consumer/variant无 truth eligibility/verifier时失败。
4. Full/read-only/partial permissions逐 action与 production catalog/verifier一致，truth class与 permission class不可混淆。
5. Browser-session/persistent Cookie attributes、server idle/absolute deadlines、refresh/revocation/credential lifecycle在 DB/credential/proof/JWT/Cookie/storage consumers上得到相同 verdict。
6. Canonical/bypass/legacy roots/receipts/consumers物理逻辑隔离；parallel variants/rerun只清 operation-owned sessions/credentials/proofs，无 cross-user/admin/device revocation或 duplicate tokens/proofs。
7. 普通 receipts/logs/traces/screenshots/CI artifacts/env/args无 JWT/Cookie/credential/recovery/proof secret。
8. Acceptance receipt记录 source、input/registry/consumer inventory/canonical/bypass-legacy/permissions/duration/refresh/scanner/mutation/isolation/privacy results、warnings与 contentDigest。
9. status=accepted仅在 violations=0、all mutations killed、consumer parity exact、secret leaks=0、warnings=0 时签发。

## 固定约束

- #2694/#2181–#2183/#1713 是实现/事实 owners；本 issue只验证。
- 只允许修改 scanner、mutation fixtures、evidence generator/tests。
- 禁止 hand-sign/direct DB/bypass/legacy fallback、allowlist、自动修复或减少 variants。
- 不修改 #1794。

## 必须测试

1. 合法 cleanup/registry/session receipts正向。
2. input missing/stale/tamper/cross-source/profile/revision失败。
3. 父票十一项与十类 legacy/bypass mutation全部被杀死。
4. permission catalog/action verdict drift失败。
5. Cookie/server duration或 refresh/revocation/credential verdict drift失败。
6. canonical/bypass/legacy cross-read或 consumer未声明 truth class失败。
7. parallel/rerun cross-session/user/admin/device cleanup与 duplicate proof/token失败。
8. JWT/Cookie/credential/proof secret进入 ordinary artifact失败。
9. renamed reader/compat/permission map/second producer被 scanner识别。
10. warning/unknown/not-observed或 terminal receipt tamper失败。

## 验收条件

- [ ] `node tools/test/check-auth-truth-governance.mjs` 返回0 violations。
- [ ] `node --test tests/tools/auth-truth-governance.test.mjs tests/tools/auth-truth-cleanup.test.mjs` 通过。
- [ ] hand-signed JWT/direct DB/placeholder/legacy strength/step-up flag/permission hardcode/compat/second producer残留为0。
- [ ] Truth/permission/Cookie duration/refresh/revocation/credential verdict完全一致。
- [ ] canonical/bypass/legacy隔离、owned cleanup与 secret ordinary leakage=0。
- [ ] `fsusblog.auth-truth-acceptance.v1` accepted、warnings=0、可独立重算。

## 非目标

- 不实现或修复 #2694/#2181–#2183。
- 不修改 production auth/session/proof/permission/duration policies。
- 不测试完整 login/admin UI或修复产品缺陷。
title: evidence(test-fixtures): auth truth 权限与 refresh 收敛验收
